summary: This Form 6-K is a routine periodic report by Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacifico (Pacific Airport Group), a Mexican airport operator, announcing preliminary terminal passenger traffic figures for July 2026. It contains monthly operational data across its Mexican and Jamaican airports, with comparisons to prior year and year-to-date figures. No corporate transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, or special situation is mentioned. The filing provides no deal terms, advisor mentions, or board recommendations. As such, it does not qualify as a special-situation event and is classified as None with high confidence.
